description: This file defines a Spring REST controller providing HTTP endpoints for Employee operations, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employees. It also includes handling for preview systems and edge cases like non-numeric IDs.

classes.name: EmployeeRestEndpoint
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that handles HTTP requests related to Employee management, including fetching, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employees. It also manages special cases for preview systems and non-numeric IDs.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an employee by numeric ID and returns a JSON representation wrapped in ResponseEntity.

methods.name: literalEmployeeIdCompatibility
methods.description: Provides a conflict response when a placeholder of an employee ID is used literally in a URL, indicating incorrect usage in preview systems.

methods.name: getEmployeeFallback
methods.description: Handles requests with non-numeric IDs; attempts to fetch by numeric conversion, otherwise returns a 404 error with a message.

methods.name: listEmployeesForPreview
methods.description: Returns a static list of example employees for preview purposes, using existing employee service calls.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new employee based on provided EmployeeResource.

methods.name: updateExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing employee using data from EmployeeResource.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployee
methods.description: Deletes an employee identified by employeeId via a DELETE request.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Helper method to escape special characters in strings for safe JSON string construction.
